cards.label: slot seal
cards.description: In this synthetic protocol, slot seal attaches a slot number before storage and rejects an update when its slot number is older than the stored number.
cards.objective: Explain how slot seal rejects an older update.

cards.label: lantern check
cards.description: In this synthetic protocol, lantern check sends a probe to each station and marks a station unavailable after two consecutive unanswered probes.
cards.objective: Explain when lantern check marks a station unavailable.

cards.label: ribbon log
cards.description: In this synthetic protocol, ribbon log appends an operation before acknowledging it and replays acknowledged operations in recorded order after restart.
cards.objective: Explain how ribbon log preserves operation order after restart.

cards.label: parcel window
cards.description: In this synthetic protocol, parcel window allows four unacknowledged parcels and resumes sending only after an acknowledgement frees a slot.
cards.objective: Explain when parcel window resumes sending.

review.progression: Socratic incorrect history question→partial hint→explanation→new-topic question; correct Socratic attempt receives explanation; explanatory correct-attempt follow-up remains generic.

sample_size_rationale: Four profiles/attempt histories × four fixed turns exercise continuation and topic reset after restart; no precision estimate or learning effect
limitations: Baseline descriptive comparison only; not randomized matched treatment effect
